evals.name: readme
evals.prompt: Write a README for this S3 Storage Viewer project.
evals.expected_output: A README.md grounded in the real code: accurate description, real npm scripts, the actual env vars from CLAUDE.md/.env.example, real project structure. Tech stack mentions Next.js 16, React 19, AWS SDK.

evals.name: api-reference
evals.prompt: Generate API reference docs for the src/lib/s3.ts module.
evals.expected_output: Reference markdown documenting each public export of s3.ts (listPrefix, presignGet, contentTypeFromKey, etc.) with real signatures, params, return types, and runnable examples. AWS SDK types/usage should be verified via Context7.

evals.name: architecture
evals.prompt: Document the architecture — how does a browse request flow from the URL through middleware to S3 and back?
evals.expected_output: An architecture/data-flow doc tracing a browse request: middleware auth redirect, the browse catch-all route, listPrefix call to S3, render. Names real files and components, explains the auth model and runtime split.
